notes.title: First Fusion Mage Update
notes.notes: [h1]What is Fusion Mage?[/h1][h2][i]A spell-casting roguelite[/i][/h2][p]Fusion Mage is a work in progress. This is a solo project, and I want to continue developing Fusion Mage's core to produce two separate game modes, [b]Survival[/b] and [b]Adventure.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Both game modes share core elements that were developed first:[/p][list][*][p]Element-swapping spell system[/p][/*][*][p]Character attributes[/p][/*][*][p]Items that change game plans[/p][/*][*][p]Meaningful buffs and debuffs[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Survival[/h2][list][*][p]Infinite spawning monsters[/p][/*][*][p]Shops for upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Progressive difficulty[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Adventure*[/h2][p]*WIP Tools so far:[/p][list][*][p]'Sector' generation with connected nodes for level selection[/p][/*][*][p]Templated procedural terrain for temples/dungeons[/p][/*][*][p]Noisey procedural generation for caves/outdoor[/p][/*][*][p]Barriers destructible by some elements[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586295/c01aa549d86a2230f067f217706e57eb157d6151.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Survival[/b] is playable on Steam now via the demo, but is still in development. It serves as a test ground for item combos and the runs are simple.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Adventure[/b] is the game mode in development since the start: a focus on spells, trinkets, and randomness in a world with more choices. You'll select levels on a map to fight tougher enemies, collect gems, buy items, and find each element.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm happy to continue developing both modes, and I look forward to a full release of Fusion Mage [i]in the future...[/i][/p]
